channel.title: 3mpwr App - Curated Disability News
channel.description: Daily curated news on disability rights, accessibility, and benefits across Canada

item.title: American podiatrist leaving Nova Scotia over bureaucratic frustrations
item.description: A U.S. podiatrist says he is leaving the province because his patients have to wait years to see a surgeon for procedures on their feet, even though he's trained to do the procedures in his clinic.
item.dc:creator: 3mpwr App Curator

item.title: Ontario extending transit fare integration program by 2 years
item.description: Transportation Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria announced the extension of OneFare, which the government says saves transit users up to $1,600 per year, on Monday.

item.title: Ford government takes over northern Ontario school board
item.description: A ministry report in October outlined what it called overwhelming dysfunction at the Near North District School Board and suggested ministry intervention.

item.title: Vancouver International Black Film Festival returns for its fifth edition
item.description: A hybrid lineup of films, panels, and workshops spotlights creators from Canada and around the world.

item.title: Northern B.C. bitcoin mines are transitioning into AI data centres
item.description: Iren, the company behind major data centres in northern B.C. is converting its infrastructure from bitcoin mining into AI storage. The Australia-based company is upgrading equipment at its sites in Prince George, Mackenzie and Canal Flats sites.

item.title: All of Toronto's speed cameras are gone. How did we get to this point?
item.description: Toronto's speed cameras may be gone, but this time there are no mysterious vandals wielding power tools, no blurry suspect photos and no police investigation.
